notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.8 - Noise, New User Experience
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38838785/083f349326781c38cfc18c1b8222b42128784082.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Updated New-User-Experience! (Now split into 4 short parts) - Automatically starts the very first time you start Synthspace or you can replay it at any time from the menu (Tutorial > Controls)
[*]Added voiceover to New User Experience
[*]Fixed a crash that could happen during loading
[*]Much better handling of shadow distance - both large and small rooms should look much better now!
[*]Increased visibility of modules that are not directly hit by a light
[*]Lots of little improvements all over the place
[*]NEW MODULE: N (Noise)
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38838785/c324d0b77669238b120830909a2f714aef439031.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*]NEW Module: [b]CONTROL Knobs[/b]
[previewyoutube=C0XHGR0LY88;full][/previewyoutube]
[*]First draft of second [b]tutorial[/b] added (as a better gateway from "what is sound" to build-your-own)
[previewyoutube=fMMhawyyrAw;full][/previewyoutube]
[*]Tweaked all GATE levels to be more in line with physical synths

[*][b]Stereo OUT[/b] module now has a [b]mono mode[/b] - plug in only the left input and it plays the same signal on both speakers. Plug in the right side as well to go back to stereo.

[*][b]Sample Player[/b] now automatically triggers when switching modes (Loop, Ping-Pong, One-Shot)

[*][b]Patterns [/b]are now [b]included in save files[/b] and are correctly loaded back as cartridges on load! (even when shared via code)
[/list]

Please be aware that Samples are not included with save files and not shared via code. They are simply saved to disk and the [i]filename[/i] is included with the save. On load, the app looks for the file and turns it into a cartridge if found. Known issue: Sample Player display goes weird sometimes on load - just take out the cartridge - optionally shake and blow into it - and reattach it to fix! ;)

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.5
notes.content:
New Module: [b]SWITCH [/b]- Four signals go in, only one of them goes out. Send a gate signal to the "switch" input to cycle between the signals. 
[previewyoutube=APSU2i41-y4;full][/previewyoutube]
LED on [b]LFO[/b]
[previewyoutube=6ps2JBvBC6I;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Oscilloscope [/b]display is now more stable
Reworked parts of the [b]Sequencer[/b] - reset now pauses the sequence, so you can link sequences together more easily!
[b]Sample and Hold[/b] now outputs a random value if triggered without an input signal present
Fixes and improvements for the [b]Math[/b] module
